about.title: Lemon Grove Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a crash on Lemon Grove Avenue, Broadway, or SR-94 takes someone's life, the grief is only the beginning. Families are often left sorting through funeral arrangements, lost income, and unanswered questions about what happened. San Diego County recorded 5 traffic deaths in Lemon Grove in the most recent final crash year, alongside dozens of injury collisions on the same corridors. Behind every number is a household trying to figure out what comes next. California law gives certain family members a path to pursue accountability through a civil wrongful death claim, separate from any police investigation or criminal charges. LawProactive is a free service that connects grieving families with an independent personal injury attorney familiar with these cases. There's no obligation to move forward, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless a recovery is made. You don't have to figure this out alone.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to specific people, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, and extending to certain dependents or heirs if none exist. An independent attorney can help sort out who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: A Deadline That Doesn't Wait
items.desc: California generally gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Getting connected early helps preserve your options before evidence or availability fades.

items.title: Losses That Go Beyond the Obvious
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. These losses are real even when they're hard to put a number on, and an attorney can help account for them.

items.question: How is a wrongful death claim different from a criminal case?
items.answer: A criminal case, if one exists, is brought by the state and focuses on punishing the driver or party responsible. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action brought by the family to recover financial losses and other damages. The two can proceed independently of each other, and one doesn't have to conclude before the other begins.

items.question: My family lost someone in a crash near SR-94 in Lemon Grove. What should we do first?
items.answer: Try to get a copy of the police report and preserve any documentation related to the crash, funeral costs, or lost income. From there, connecting with an independent attorney can help clarify who in your family has standing to file and what the realistic timeline looks like. LawProactive can make that connection at no cost to you.

items.question: What if we can't afford an attorney right now?
items.answer: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means there's no upfront fee and no fee at all unless there's a recovery. This is meant to remove the financial barrier so families can get guidance during an already difficult time. There's also no obligation to move forward after speaking with someone.
